Geographies Served Programs Skill Training and Livelihoods District Bangalore Bangalore Rural State Karnataka District Bangalore Bangalore Rural States Karnataka Giving young men and women the chance to develop their skills will enable them to achieve long-term sustainable livelihoods, encourage entrepreneurship, and advance their careers. Runs the following centers: Pragati Skill Development Center: The six-month courses in Tailoring and Screen Printing, Home Management for Domestic Workers, Electronic Assembly Work, Desktop Publishing (DTP), Computer Office Applications, Beauty Care, and Graphic Design are all offered by Pragati Skill Development Center. especially instruction in cosmetic care and tailoring. Centers for Community Training: In addition to providing many of the same skills as Pragati (such as tailoring, beauty care, MS Office, and DTP), the community centers, which are situated throughout the eight assembly constituencies that NMGCT serves, also provide courses in retail assistant, medical coding, CRM (customer relations management), and Tally accounting. Education District Bangalore Bangalore Rural State Karnataka District Bangalore Bangalore Rural States Karnataka Serves roughly sixty socially disadvantaged children from Bengaluru's slum cluster areas. Two local teachers and around five mentors supervise the activities at this Free Learning Center (FLC) in their separate communities. Children in primary and high school, the majority of whom attend government schools, spend two hours a day at these after-school care centers (FLCs) in an effort to keep them off the streets. The teachers assist the kids with their homework during these times and help them achieve the academic standards anticipated for their particular grades. Their progress is reviewed with the teachers of each school. Children are encouraged to participate in sports, cultural events, and quiz contests in addition to their academic studies. Parents and children can attend counselling sessions on community health and personal cleanliness. Workshops are offered on a regular basis to impart morals, ethics, and social responsibilities.
